status_detail: On 9 March 2026 parliament passed Law No. 41/2026 (Official Gazette, supplement to issue 11, 9 March 2026), an exceptional extension of its own term to 31 May 2028 because of the 2026 Lebanon war. The vote was 76 for, 41 against, 4 abstentions. Lebanese Forces, Free Patriotic Movement and some independent MPs challenged it; on 7 April 2026 the Constitutional Council (decision 7/2026) unanimously rejected the three appeals, but said parliament must shorten the extended term and hold elections once the exceptional circumstances end. No new election date is set; the vote is expected around May 2028. The election originally scheduled for 10 May 2026 was not held. IFES lists it as Cancelled. No 2026 register figure exists; the 3,967,507 shown under national.registered is the 2022 register (UNDP).

national.registered_note: 2022 register (3,967,507, UNDP; see 2022-parliamentary.json). Not a 2026 figure; IFES does not give a voter count for this election.
